claims.statement: For linear undirected bond probabilities C |x-y|^(-1-sigma) on Z, p_c = 1 + zeta(2+2 sigma)/(2 zeta(1+sigma)^2) + O(sigma^3) as sigma decreases to zero.

For even probability kernels on Z with zero diagonal, positive nearest-neighbour weights, Fourier transform less than one off zero, nonempty admissible percolating set, and uniform bounds max D=O(epsilon), J_2,3=O(epsilon^2), J_3,2=O(epsilon^3), p_c=1+sum D^2+O(epsilon^3).
For nonnegative summable additions b_n of uniformly bounded total mass, the normalized power-law kernel has quadratic correction [zeta(2)+2 sum b_n/n+sum b_n^2]/2, with uniform cubic remainder.

For probability mixtures of normalized kernels with exponents c s and c in a fixed positive compact interval, the quadratic coefficient is (pi^2/12)(integral c d nu)^2, uniformly over mixing measures.
